## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short Esoteric ritual manual preserved only in the Manji Xùzàngjīng (卍 Xuzangjing, X02 no. 188), attributed to the Tang Esoteric translator under the name **Āmójiā** 阿謨伽 (= Sanskrit *Amogha* = abbreviated *Amoghavajra*; see [阿謨伽](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%98%BF%E8%AC%A8%E4%BC%BD) for the name analysis). The text is not preserved in the Taishō main canon and exists only via the supplementary Xùzàngjīng line.

**Abstract**

The text presents a compendium of *mìmì yàoshù* 祕密要術 ("essential secret techniques") — a collection of *mudrā*, *mantra*, and *maṇḍala*-instructions for various Esoteric rites. As a Xùzàngjīng-only text, it represents the supplementary stratum of Esoteric ritual manuals that circulated in late-Tang and Sòng monastic communities outside the principal canonical line. Attribution to **Āmójiā** (alternate name of **Amoghavajra** [不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) places the text within his school but its authentic Amoghavajra-origin is uncertain — the Xùzàngjīng-only status and the name-form 阿謨伽 (rather than the standard 不空) suggest possible later compilation under his name. The catalog meta records the catalog form 阿謨伽; the prose treatment correlates this with [不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA).
